306:t_002:10.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「To survive! You've got no right to complain to me!」

306:t_002:11.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「I heard your trail went cold around here. I figured you'd run for $$ＥＸ－１０$$, and it's exactly as I predicted.」

306:t_002:12.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Do you see now? My strategic eye even surpasses $$ゼロ$$'s cunning!」

306:t_002:13.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「It seems that overly self-important man has outplayed us for once.」

306:t_002:14.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Even so, at least the $$ラムダ・ドライバ$$-equipped lunatic and the tacky gold-plated thug aren't here.」

306:t_002:15.en:
$$スザク$$
「Since our enemy isn't the $$サイデリアル$$, the $$マーティアル$$ won't come out...! We have no choice but to fight on our own!」

306:t_002:17.en:
$$マオ$$
「On top of that, our machines are at 80% of peak condition at best. It's pretty rough.」

306:t_002:18.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「But we have no choice. Before the main force arrives, we take these guys out and get through the jungle.」

306:t_002:19.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「The operation window is six minutes! If we run past that, we could end up in a fatal situation!」

306:t_002:20.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Heh... heh heh. I can already picture the faces of $$ゲイツ$$ and $$ベック$$ gnashing their teeth...」

306:t_002:21.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Let's go, $$キリコ$$! No need to wait for the main force! I'll settle things with you right here!」

306:t_003:0.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「They're tougher than I imagined. But it's no fun for me either if they croak that easily.」

306:t_003:1.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「You people owe me plenty, after all.」

306:t_003:3.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Shut up, $$カレン$$! It all started when you disobeyed my orders at $$クメン$$ - that was the beginning of my downfall!」

306:t_003:4.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「$$キリコ$$! And $$シャッコ$$, $$カレン$$, $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$! You four I will never forgive!」

306:t_003:5.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「...Then might you spare the rest of us, the other members?」

306:t_003:7.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Oho, $$ロジャー・スミス$$. Like a true Negotiator, you plan to talk your way out of this?」

306:t_003:8.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That is my proper line of work.」

306:t_003:9.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「What do you say, Mr. $$カン・ユー$$? We cannot afford to be wiped out here...」

306:t_003:10.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「I see. So you'll turn a blind eye to a few sacrifices.」

306:t_003:11.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Sacrifice the lesser to save the greater... Four lives to save five. A simple arithmetic problem.」

306:t_003:12.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「$$ロジャー・スミス$$! Are you going to sell out your comrades!?」

306:t_003:13.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I'm disappointed in you, $$ゼロ$$. That you would let emotion sway you and lose sight of efficiency.」

306:t_003:14.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「I am securing my own safety first, and at the same time protecting you, the strategist of $c, as my top priority.」

306:t_003:15.en:
$$カレン$$
「N-no way! $$ロジャー$$ would never say something like that! It's a lie!!」

306:t_003:16.en:
$$マオ$$
「I'm disappointed in you, $$ロジャー$$!」

306:t_003:17.en:
$$クルツ$$
「You lousy negotiator! Silver-tongued swindler, steamroller with no logic, posing crow bastard!」

306:t_003:18.en:
$$ドロシー#bigo$$
「What terrible things to say.」

306:t_003:19.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「...Say what you like. I am only carrying out my duty to protect you.」

306:t_003:20.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「How unsightly, $c. Infighting, and at a time like this.」

306:t_003:21.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Frankly, I'm nearly fed up with them myself. In that case, it might be an option to think only of how I alone can survive.」

306:t_003:22.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「You, you're planning to defect to us?」

306:t_003:23.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「What do you say? I'm confident I can be of some use.」

306:t_003:24.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Hahahaha, fool! If you thought I'd accept such a demand, you are sorely mistaken!」

306:t_004:0.en:
$$スザク$$
「As expected, he had reinforcements ready!」

306:t_004:2.en:
$$カン・ユー$$
「Just as $$ベック$$ told me, you useless Negotiator! I'd like to hear what on earth you meant by this pointless negotiation!」

306:t_004:3.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「...That was no negotiation at all.」

306:t_004:4.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「It was only stalling for time.」

306:t_004:6.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「Is that wise, $$カン・ユー$$? Your trump card is already hanging by a thread.」

306:t_005:0.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Enemy unit confirmed! They haven't been able to respond to us!」

306:t_006:2.en:
$n
「Miss $$スズネ$$ and I are both safe on our end!」

306:t_006:3.en:
$$マオ$$
「You're late, $n! Thanks to you, we had to delay their reinforcements with some lousy acting!」

306:t_006:5.en:
$$スザク$$
「It's all right. You made it in time.」

306:t_006:6.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Lousy acting is unkind, $$マオ$$. Isn't it rude to me, who endured my comrades' bitter words to play the villain?」

306:t_006:7.en:
$$マオ$$
「Sorry, sorry. It was a great performance, Mr. Negotiator.」

306:t_006:8.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We who played along in supporting roles would like some praise too.」

306:t_006:11.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「A despicable man like you. Of course we had anticipated that you'd have reinforcements ready.」

306:t_006:12.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「After $n contacted us to say he would rejoin us shortly, we were timing things so that he could play our trump card.」

306:t_006:13.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Though there was one individual who used that as an excuse to hurl abuse at me...」

306:t_006:14.en:
$$クルツ$$
「H-hey, $n! How was the week alone with Miss $$スズネ$$!?」

306:t_006:17.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「He's calling her by her bare name!?」

306:t_006:19.en:
$$スズネ$$
「Honestly, $n! Is this the time for jokes? Think about it.」

306:t_006:21.en:
$$シャッコ$$
「Enough of the reunion greetings.」

306:t_006:24.en:
$$カレン$$
「We've both shown all our cards! From here on, it's a head-on fight!」

306:t_007:0.en:
$n
「$$ジェニオン$$ has taken heavy damage. I'll go back up $$ロジャー$$.」

306:t_007:1.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Understood. It seems you've had a hard time as well.」

306:t_007:2.en:
$n
「Even so, if I got to see everyone like this...」

306:t_007:3.en:
$$カレン$$
「Aren't you sweet to say that!」

306:t_007:4.en:
$n
「Coming from you, $$カレン$$, that sounds odd...」

306:t_007:5.en:
$$カレン$$
「Retracted! Make up for being late by working hard!」
